character: Ramesh Bhai — market general store, ~₹12,000/day sales, 2 helpers
premise: Relatable MSME shop (₹10k+/day). WhatsApp/Excel chaos → Sheetomatic FMS, IMS, CRM, Tasks, weekly review.

posts.title: Ramesh Bhai: ₹12k/day, WhatsApp pe business
posts.caption:
Ramesh Bhai ka shop.
Roz ~₹12,000+ sale.
Do helper. Ek WhatsApp.

Customer: “Bhaiya, kal wala order?”
Supplier: “Payment kab?”
Helper: “Stock hai kya?”

Teen chats. Ek dimaag — Ramesh ka.

Sale toh chal rahi hai…
par business WhatsApp pe tair raha hai.

Agar aapka bhi din yahin atka hai — comment SHOP.
Sheetomatic isi chaos ko system banata hai.

#MSME #KiranaBusiness #Sheetomatic #WhatsAppChaos
posts.storyHook: Ramesh Bhai — market general store, ~₹12,000/day sales, 2 helpers

posts.title: Ek follow-up bhoola = ek customer gaya
posts.caption:
Same shop. Same day.

Ramesh ne socha: “Follow-up main yaad rakh lunga.”

3 customer bole — “rate bhejo”.
2 ko quotation gaya.
1 ko nahi.

Woh 1 wala competitor ke paas chala gaya.
Sale miss. Quiet. No alarm.

CRM matlab fancy software nahi.
Matlab: kaun bola, kya bola, next step kab.

Comment LEAD agar aapke shop pe bhi “yaad rakhunga” chal raha hai.

#CRM #MSMEIndia #Sheetomatic

posts.title: FINAL rates v3 — teen jagah truth
posts.caption:
Ramesh ki notebook mein likha tha:
FINAL rates v3

Phone pe Excel.
WhatsApp pe photo.
Counter pe sticky note.

Teen jagah “truth”.
Ek bhi trust nahi.

Sheetomatic ek jagah rakhta hai —
order, follow-up, stock signal.

Save this if your shop also runs on FINAL_FINAL files.

posts.title: Raat ka message, subah cold customer
posts.caption:
Raat 9 baje shop band.
Phone on.

“Kal subah baat karte hain.”

Subah tak message scroll mein duba.
Customer cool.

₹10k+/day shop ko bhi yeh leak mehnga padta hai.

Comment NIGHT — night leads ko cold hone se kaise bachayein, bataunga.

posts.storyHook: Ramesh Bhai — market general store, ~₹12,000/day sales, 2 helpers

posts.title: Stock hai? Lagta hai hai.
posts.caption:
“Bhaiya stock hai?”

Helper: “Lagta hai hai.”
Ramesh: “Count karke bata.”
Customer wait. Queue. Mood kharab.

₹12k/day sale…
stock abhi bhi andaaza.

IMS ka kaam fancy ERP nahi —
10 second mein sach bolna:
kitna hai, kahan hai, kab reorder.

Comment STOCK agar aapka answer bhi “lagta hai” hai.

posts.title: Shelf khali — sale ready, item nahi
posts.caption:
Supplier ne 2 carton late kiye.
Ramesh ko pata chala jab shelf khali dikhi.

Sale thi.
Item nahi.

Yeh stock-out silent killer hai —
WhatsApp group mein shor nahi,
margin mein chhed zaroor.

Sheetomatic reorder signal + simple stock board.

Comment REORDER.

posts.title: Helper gaya toh data kahan?
posts.caption:
Ramesh ka fear:
helper chala gaya toh numbers kahan?

Stock Excel personal Drive mein.
Access uske Gmail pe.

Aaj ki MSME reality:
data ownership = business ownership.

Sheetomatic workspace mein data shop ka rehta hai — personal chat ka nahi.

posts.title: Chhota stock rhythm jo kaam karta hai
posts.caption:
Chhota checklist jo Ramesh ab try karta hai:

1) Subah top 20 items count
2) Red items list
3) Reorder call before 11
4) Evening mismatch note

Pehle memory.
Ab rhythm.

System aasaan hota hai jab roz chhota ho.

posts.storyHook: Ramesh Bhai — market general store, ~₹12,000/day sales, 2 helpers

posts.title: Kal pakka bhej dena — promise toot gaya
posts.caption:
Customer: “Kal pakka bhej dena.”
Ramesh: “Ho jayega.”

Kal.
Courier late.
Koi owner nahi.
Customer call — Ramesh pe.

Har “kal bhej denge” ek promise hai.
Promise chat mein chhupi toh toot bhi silent.

FMS = flow:
order → pack → dispatch → delivered
har step ka owner + time.

Comment PROMISE.

#FMS #MSME #CustomerTrust #Sheetomatic

posts.title: Stuck order dikhta kyun nahi?
posts.caption:
Ramesh ke shop pe order stuck kyun hote hain?

Kyunki stuck dikhta hi nahi.
WhatsApp scroll mein dab jata hai.

Sheetomatic FMS mein stuck stage red hota hai —
pehle customer chillane se.

Agar aap bhi sirf escalate hone pe jaante ho — comment STUCK.

posts.title: Main kar deta hoon ≠ ho gaya
posts.caption:
Helper bola: “Main kar deta hoon.”
Ramesh assume: ho gaya.

Shaam ko nahi hua.

Task without owner = wish.
Task with due + owner = work.

Sheetomatic Tasks / EA rhythm yahi sikhata hai.

Comment TASK.

posts.title: Sale badhegi, chaos 5x hoga
posts.caption:
Ramesh ki learning (mehangi padhi):

Sale badhna ≠ system hona.
₹10k se ₹20k/day jab jaoge,
chaos 2x nahi — 5x hota hai.

Pehle leak band karo.
Phir scale.

Sheetomatic Build → Manage → Scale.

Comment SCALE.

posts.title: 11:40 pm lead — subah tak cold
posts.caption:
Raat 11:40.
Naya WhatsApp:
“Bulk chahiye. Rate?”

Ramesh so raha.
Subah dekha — late.
Customer already dusri shop pe.

Night lead cold = silent loss.
₹10k+/day shop ke liye bhi.

WhatsApp AI + CRM handoff:
reply → qualify → human.

Comment NIGHTLEAD.
